assessment_basis: Closed cited SUPPORT/CONTEXT bundle and ordinary linguistic interpretation; not a fresh provider observation. Full mapping inspected only to diagnose what is uncited, never to fill a support gap.

components.rationale: The SUPPORT states live alternatives or explicitly says the current evidence does not distinguish them. Resolving the named alternatives at the stated evidence scope preserves the contrast without inventing an outcome. Reviewed closed bundle: P001 SUPPORT.

The SUPPORT explicitly selects this next operation. Cited context preserves the alternatives and applicable scope. No action is inferred merely from a possible diagnostic outcome. Reviewed closed bundle: P002 SUPPORT, P001 CONTEXT.

The SUPPORT bundle states both outcome-to-alternative preferences, including their conditions. Cited context supplies the selected operation and live alternatives where these occupy separate spans. Preference is retained as preference, without an assertion of certainty. Reviewed closed bundle: P003 SUPPORT, P004 SUPPORT, P001 CONTEXT, P002 CONTEXT.
